hero.title: Intelligent Conversational Crime Intelligence Platform
hero.description: An AI-powered investigation and crime analytics platform for Karnataka State Police to analyze, search, and map crime data dynamically.

capabilities.sectionSubtitle: Advanced crime analytics modules designed for police investigators and supervisors.
capabilities.card1Desc: Ask questions in natural language. The system translates queries to safe SQL and fetches records from the central database.
capabilities.card2Desc: Geospatial coordinate mapping with automated density calculation. Instantly identify crime concentrations across jurisdictions.
capabilities.card3Desc: Visualise networks of co-accused, associate links, and geographic associations. Track gang structures across police stations.
capabilities.card4Desc: Compile investigation briefs instantly. KSP-ConAI parses timelines, detects missing milestones, and exports formatted PDF outputs.

workflow.sectionSubtitle: How KSP-ConAI securely processes crime data from registration to resolution.
workflow.step1Desc: Securely sync daily FIR records to the KSP relational Data Store.
workflow.step2Desc: Semantic intelligence engine indexes names, offenses, and crime parameters for fast retrieval.
workflow.step3Desc: Analyze relationship links to identify offender associations.
workflow.step4Desc: Generate grounded summaries, execute audit logging, and export briefs.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Data Protection Guidelines
privacy.sec1Desc: This privacy policy governs all data collection, ingestion, and query operations within KSP-ConAI (Karnataka State Police Crime Intelligence Platform). Access is strictly limited to active law enforcement officers, intelligence analysts, and authorized system supervisors.
privacy.sec2Desc: KSP-ConAI processes official FIR records, suspect listings, case diaries, and geospatial coordinates synced directly from state police databases. No personal public data is stored or crawled outside of authorized police networks.
privacy.sec3Desc: To prevent misuse and guarantee algorithmic validation, every query, conversational prompt, and executed SQL retrieval is logged alongside user identity metadata. Audits are stored in encrypted logs and reviewed monthly by departmental supervisors.
privacy.sec4Desc: Data inside KSP-ConAI is encrypted both in transit (using TLS 1.3) and at rest (using AES-256). Session validation is strictly managed through the KSP platform Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication protocols.
privacy.sec5Desc: Case materials, summaries, and compiled briefs are preserved in compliance with the Karnataka Police Manual and official digital archiving directives.

terms.title: Terms of Service & Operational Guidelines
terms.sec1Desc: The KSP-ConAI platform is provided exclusively for official Karnataka State Police investigation, analysis, and law enforcement support. Unauthorized access, sharing of credentials, or using the system for non-official inquiries is strictly prohibited and subject to disciplinary and legal action.
terms.sec2Desc: Users are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login credentials. Any security compromise must be reported immediately to the KSP System Administration Team.
terms.sec3Desc: While the platform uses advanced AI models to synthesize and analyze case details, all AI-generated text, summaries, and network graphs must be verified against primary case diaries and official FIR files before submission to courts or supervisors.
terms.sec4Desc: By authenticating and using this portal, you explicitly consent to continuous recording, monitoring, and auditing of all user activities, database lookups, and session timelines.

disclaimer.title: Usage Disclaimer & Operational Notice
disclaimer.noticeDesc: This system is restricted to Karnataka State Police personnel only. All transactions are logged and actively audited.
disclaimer.sec1Desc: KSP-ConAI is a support tool designed to assist investigators in parsing large volumes of case records. The recommendations, summaries, and relationship networks generated by the system do not constitute final legal findings.
disclaimer.sec2Desc: Information retrieved from the conversational SQL engine or maps must be validated against the certified records of the respective police stations before being introduced as evidence in any judicial proceedings.
disclaimer.sec3Desc: The Karnataka State Police Datathon 2026 releases this system as an operational preview. Access may be temporarily modified, limited, or suspended for security maintenance without prior notice.
